doctrine: Train a compact V2-native model on the surface V2 actually sources today, validate after-cost edge in paper/shadow before any canary, and only expand inputs / size after operator-approved gates.

stages.name: training_spec_authoring
constraints: compact architecture with reserved slots for later expanded inputs

families: v2_prediction (expected move, after-cost, calibrated confidence, block reasons)
v2_paper_context (positions, ledger, intents, held intents, position-price track, position-history tracker)

objectives.name: edge_after_cost
objectives.definition: signed P&L per trade after fee + slippage in basis points
objectives.target: strictly positive expectation across rolling windows with bootstrap CI

objectives.name: downside_pre_cascade_recall
objectives.definition: detect liquidation-class drawdowns before they become unrecoverable
objectives.target: high recall on pre-cascade-shock events even at cost of precision

objectives.name: risk_gateway_compliance
objectives.definition: model output must never override the risk gateway
objectives.target: penalize trades the risk gateway would have blocked

stages.name: evaluation_gates
gates: minimum after-cost expectancy with bootstrap CI lower bound > 0 (operator-set)
maximum drawdown over rolling window <= operator-set bound

stages.name: codex_review_routing
requirements: Codex verifies no checkpoint blob deserialization happened
Codex verifies no policy architecture port was started
Codex verifies no exchange mutation occurred
Codex verifies paper soak ran exclusively on v2:* keys

stages.name: operator_gate_for_canary
requirements: operator sets 10 numeric caps in capital_recovery_gate_model.json
operator approves canary parameters (canary_order_size, symbol scope, kill switch)
operator separately approves live_gate flip from blocked_human_only
